description: This is a Java source file defining the LogFragment class, which extends Android's Fragment class. It provides a fragment containing a LogView wrapped in a ScrollView, designed to display log messages in an Android application.

classes.name: LogFragment
classes.description: An Android Fragment that creates a view hierarchy containing a LogView within a ScrollView to display log data.

methods.name: inflateViews
methods.description: Initializes and constructs the view hierarchy programmatically, creating a ScrollView containing a LogView with specific styling and layout.

methods.name: onCreateView
methods.description: Overrides Fragment's lifecycle method to inflate views and set up a TextWatcher to auto-scroll the log view when text changes.

methods.name: getLogView
methods.description: Public accessor method to retrieve the LogView instance contained within the fragment.
